capabilities: Get inline suggestions as you type and accept or dismiss them
Chat with Copilot models in a right-sidebar panel
Link notes in chat with [[double bracket syntax]]
Render Mermaid diagrams in chat responses
Configure suggestion delay, keybindings, scope, and excluded folders
extras: Inline suggestions require a Node.js 22+ binary path configured in settings; known issues with Flatpak installs and Tab keybinding conflicts are documented. Chat response streaming is not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use a GitHub Copilot subscription for inline completions or chat about your notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a bridge between the Obsidian editor and the GitHub Copilot service.

summary: Bridge that brings GitHub Copilot inline suggestions and Copilot Chat with note linking into the Obsidian editor.
